These files don’t show up when a user browses the file system with a GUI or when using normal commands on the command line. Users must explicitly ask to show the hidden files either via a series of Graphical User Interface (GUI) prompts or with command line switches (dir /a for Windows and ls –a for Linux and macOS).

strings: Also answer me if you have considered my allegations and what you will do about it.

If your employee claimed a secure payment with his messages until the payment, and after the payment and his check that the payment was legal, he did not confirm the payment, but stopped reporting, it only indicates fraud.
I don't think your company, hao reputable, needs it, and it casts a shadow on it.
If you do not answer me, I will send that letter and this urgency to the bank's headquarters in Liechtenstein, as well as to the competent FMA end FCA.
